The English omits the named guide 田光嗣 (Tian Guangsi), and 兒女六人 means six sons and daughters; "grandchildren" is not in the source.

本州 means "this/his own prefecture", i.e. Yi prefecture which he governed, not a place called "Ben".

領 here is nominal (titular) tenure of prefectures not yet under Song control; 復其地 says the territory was recovered, not that Renyu personally recovered it.

At this point, as Shu was about to be attacked, he was again given nominal governorships of prefectures in Chuan and Xia (Sichuan and the Gorges), and these were then pacified.
領 is nominal tenure; 峽 here means the Three Gorges region, not Xia (the Tangut state).
